customer: Got a recall notice on my SUV that I haven't dealt with yet. Can I still sell it to you, or do I need to get it fixed first?
agent: Yes, we buy cars with open safety recalls, and an open recall doesn't change your offer. Recall repairs are free at a dealer for your car's brand, so you're welcome to have it fixed before selling if you like, but you don't have to. You can find more in our article "Selling a car with an open recall."
